A combination of a massive shaped block of armor and enormous integrated artillery, this vessel appears more as an unholy amalgam from the monomaniacal imagination of a deranged Domain military procurement official than a real, functioning starship. And yet it exists, with every Tri-Pad imagining analysis triggering some sort of hardcoded COMSEC blockade.


Analysis of on-board databanks has yielded a few historical clues: this is indeed a phase battleship, as unbelievable as it might seem, similar in design age with the ill-fated Grendel project.  Code-named Hrunting, the project was an attempt to push phase technology - then limited to the Domain Armada - to its absolute limits.  Orion Shipyards was selected, after the resounding success of their Onslaught-class battleship design. Unsurprisingly, inefficiencies in the design, operation and refitting led to absurd cost overruns, numerous accidents and  several project reshuffles. The project was on verge of shutdown when both the hull and existing design team were "recruited" by a black ops Domain Armada unit. All records hence were wiped, with what remains only indicating a rushed combat refitting that saw the Hrunting equipped with its modular weaponry, before departing from pages of history forever.  Elements of the design, however, have appeared in other more successful projects unrelated to phase technology.

But these answers yield more questions. What sort of threat would push Domain towards mobilizing such an absurd project? And more importantly, how such a vessel found its way to the Persean Sector, without any visible signs of battle damage, or more importantly, any signs of use? 

Where did it go? And what did it see?
